title: Vulnerability report and PoC check result

verdict.description: Orthogonal two-axis verdict: report quality across all environments plus automated reproduction readiness.

report_quality.description: NOT_OK if any report_quality check failed; OK otherwise.

auto_repro.description: MANUAL when outside the supported automated-reproduction matrix or when a file could not be analyzed at all (never a failure); NOT_READY if inside the matrix and an auto_repro check failed; NEEDS_JUDGMENT if nothing failed but at least one auto_repro check is still unknown and must be settled by the agent or --smoke; READY otherwise.

fields.description: Resolved state map for repro.json fields plus the derived repro_type (poc.py, poc.html, or poc.js).

summary.description: Concise human-readable summary of the two-axis verdict and concrete fixes when checks fail.

suggested_repro_config.description: Pre-filled repro.json to attach when the config is missing or has problems; <...> marks values the researcher must fill in. Null when the attached config passed.

checker_version.description: Version of vuln-report-check that produced the mechanical results.

id.description: Stable check id, e.g. compiles or py.server_contract.

message.description: Concise explanation citing file and line when available.

fix.description: Actionable remediation step when status is fail or info; empty string otherwise.
